framework.name: RBI Payment Aggregators Directions (2025)
framework.description: For banks and non-banks acting as payment aggregators (online, physical point-of-sale and cross-border): the baseline technology recommendations, card data rules, data localisation, annual cyber security audit, merchant due diligence, escrow and dispute handling. Payment gateways are recommended to follow the same technology baseline. Non-bank PAs also follow the RBI cyber resilience Directions for non-bank PSOs.

requirements.title: Fit-and-proper management
requirements.guidance: Professional management, with promoters and directors meeting fit-and-proper criteria.

requirements.title: Dispute mechanism and refund timelines
requirements.guidance: A dispute resolution mechanism with refund timelines, following RBI's turnaround-time rules for failed transactions.

requirements.title: Grievance officer and escalation matrix on the website
requirements.guidance: Name a grievance redressal officer and publish the escalation matrix.

requirements.title: PCI DSS, encryption and fraud prevention
requirements.guidance: Systems that detect and prevent fraud and protect customers; PCI DSS (and PA-DSS) compliance with current encryption standards.

controls.title: Cardholder data environment scope and segmentation

requirements.title: Board-approved information security policy and Annexure 1 baseline
requirements.guidance: Adopt a Board-approved information security policy and the baseline technology recommendations in Annexure 1.

controls.title: Board-level oversight of IT and cyber risk

requirements.title: Payment data stored in India
requirements.guidance: Follow the payment system data storage rules (circular of 6 April 2018): store payment data only in India.

controls.title: Payment system data stored only in India

requirements.title: Annual system and cyber security audit by a CERT-In empanelled auditor
requirements.guidance: Submit an annual system audit, including a cyber security audit by a CERT-In empanelled auditor, to the DPSS regional office.

controls.title: Independent annual IS and cyber security audit

requirements.title: Cyber resilience Directions for non-bank PSOs
requirements.guidance: Non-bank PAs also follow the cyber resilience and digital payment security Directions for non-bank PSOs (30 July 2024).

requirements.title: Refunds to the original payment method
requirements.guidance: Refund to the original payment method unless the payer instructs otherwise.

requirements.title: Merchant due diligence and background checks
requirements.guidance: Customer due diligence on merchants under the KYC Master Direction (with CKYCR retrieval), simplified checks for small merchants, and background checks.

controls.title: Merchant and partner onboarding due diligence

requirements.title: Monitor merchant transactions against their profile
requirements.guidance: Monitor merchant transactions for consistency with the merchant's business.

controls.title: Merchant and partner onboarding due diligence

requirements.title: Register with FIU-IND
requirements.guidance: Non-bank PAs register with the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU-IND).

controls.title: Contact with authorities, CERT-In point of contact

requirements.title: Escrow account with permitted credits and debits
requirements.guidance: Keep collected funds in an escrow account with a scheduled commercial bank in India, with only permitted credits and debits, an exclusive-use clause, and no cash-on-delivery use.

requirements.title: Quarterly auditor certificate on escrow
requirements.guidance: Get an auditor certificate on escrow balances every quarter, by the 15th of the following month.

controls.title: Independent annual IS and cyber security audit

requirements.title: Security risk assessments reported to the Board
requirements.guidance: Assess security risks and present them and audit reports to the Board.

controls.title: Board-level oversight of IT and cyber risk

requirements.title: Report security incidents and card data breaches to RBI
requirements.guidance: Report security incidents and card data breaches to RBI in the stipulated time, plus monthly cyber incident reports with root cause and preventive actions.

requirements.title: Security assessment of merchants at onboarding
requirements.guidance: Assess merchants' security during onboarding.

controls.title: Merchant and partner onboarding due diligence

requirements.title: Internal audits, external audit, half-yearly VAPT and PCI reports
requirements.guidance: Quarterly internal and annual external audit reports to the IT committee, half-yearly VAPT, and PCI DSS AOC or ROC.

controls.title: Approved Scanning Vendor and internal vulnerability scans

requirements.title: Annual review of the information security policy
requirements.guidance: Review the information security policy at least annually.

requirements.title: Cyber Crisis Management Plan
requirements.guidance: A Cyber Crisis Management Plan approved by the IT strategy committee.

requirements.title: Security event collection and analysis
requirements.guidance: Collect and analyse security events to raise alerts proactively.

controls.title: Centralised logging with retention in India

requirements.title: Data kept out of external jurisdictions
requirements.guidance: Take preventive measures so data is stored in infrastructure that is not in external jurisdictions.

controls.title: Payment system data stored only in India

requirements.title: No card credentials stored by merchants
requirements.guidance: Card credentials must not be stored in databases or servers that merchants can access; use tokenisation.

requirements.title: Point-of-sale terminal security
requirements.guidance: For PA-Physical: use PCI-validated terminals and protect them from tampering.

requirements.title: Cross-border transaction controls
requirements.guidance: For PA-Cross Border: follow the cross-border chapter of the Directions with your AD bank (FEMA rules, transaction limits, screening and records); confirm the specific obligations in the Direction.
